---
layout: null
permalink: /llms-full.txt
sitemap: false
figure_format: text
---
{%- comment -%}
  Each topic's Markdown source is pulled in with include_relative, so its Liquid
  (including figure includes, rendered as text via page.figure_format) runs but
  kramdown does not. Jekyll reuses the cached template of the document body, so
  front matter is normally absent already; it is stripped here if it is not.
{%- endcomment -%}
{%- capture nl %}
{% endcapture -%}
{%- assign fm_end = nl | append: "---" -%}
{%- assign notes = site.topics | where_exp: "n", "n.status != 'draft'" | sort: "date" | reverse -%}
# {{ site.title }} by {{ site.author.name }}: full text

> {{ site.description }}

Author: {{ site.author.name }} ({{ site.author.url }})
License: CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
Index: {{ '/llms.txt' | absolute_url }}
Articles: {{ notes.size }}, newest first.
{% for note in notes %}
{%- capture raw %}{% include_relative {{ note.path }} %}{% endcapture -%}
{%- assign body = raw -%}
{%- assign opening = raw | slice: 0, 3 -%}
{%- if opening == "---" -%}
  {%- assign rest = raw | remove_first: "---" -%}
  {%- assign front_matter = rest | split: fm_end | first -%}
  {%- assign body = rest | remove_first: front_matter | remove_first: fm_end -%}
{%- endif -%}
{%- comment -%} Map the inline HTML used in sources to plain text (math spans become code). {%- endcomment -%}
{%- assign body = body | replace: '<p class="equation">', '' | replace: '</p>', ''
  | replace: '<span class="math">', '`' | replace: '</span>', '`'
  | replace: '<sub>', '_' | replace: '</sub>', '' | replace: '<sup>', '^' | replace: '</sup>', ''
  | strip %}

---

# {{ note.title }}

- URL: {{ note.url | absolute_url }}
- Author: {{ site.author.name }}
- Published: {{ note.date | date: "%Y-%m-%d" }}
{%- if note.updated %}
- Updated: {{ note.updated | date: "%Y-%m-%d" }}
{%- endif %}
- Topic: {{ note.topic }}
{%- if note.tags and note.tags.size > 0 %}
- Tags: {{ note.tags | join: ", " }}
{%- endif %}
- Summary: {{ note.summary | strip_html | normalize_whitespace }}
- Citation: Gravey, M. ({{ note.updated | default: note.date | date: "%Y" }}). {{ note.title }}. Viewpoints. {{ note.url | absolute_url }}

{{ body }}
{% endfor %}
